title: AI SaaS - Sketch To Design | CodeRabbit, Convex, Inngest, Sevalla, Polar

deferred.3: Deploy on Sevalla. Opens 'is sponsored by Sevalla' [21:18] and needs a Sevalla account. Deploying an empty skeleton can wait until there is something to deploy.
deferred.6: Design & theming. He pastes a pre-made globals.css from his Figma design [91:04]; the colour values are never shown on screen. His own fallback at [88:57] is to grab a shadcn theme, which is what the project currently has.

notes: Honoured the tutorial's Next.js 15.4.6 pin [15:26] rather than upgrading; the rest of the course depends on it.
shadcn CLI changed since recording: init no longer takes --base-color and now prompts for theme presets. Wrote components.json directly with baseColor=neutral, the value asked for at [17:15].
shadcn add --all fails on a broken registry item (questionnaire.json 404s). Installed the canonical 46 components explicitly - same outcome as the 'hit A' trick at [18:02].

Skipping init meant src/lib/utils.ts, the clsx/tailwind-merge deps and the entire theme token block were never generated. All added by hand; the missing tokens are why the first render of the auth pages was unstyled.
Added suppressHydrationWarning on <html>; next-themes requires it and the video does not mention it.
Auth routes are a literal src/app/auth/ folder, not a route group. Confirmed from the file tree on screen at 27:35 - this is why /sign-up 404s for him at [27:32] and he corrects to /auth/sign-up.

Tailark blocks could not be installed via CLI (same shadcn version drift he hits at [26:19]). Rebuilt the equivalent layout from the installed shadcn primitives, matching the structure read off the frame.

Convex Auth: latest @convex-dev/auth@0.0.94 requires @auth/core ^0.41.1 and conflicts with the tutorial pin. Pinned both to the tutorial versions (@convex-dev/auth@0.0.88, @auth/core@0.37.0), which also matches the setup CLI that was run.
convex must be a project dependency before npx convex dev will run; installed convex@1.25.4 per the pin at [34:20].
Middleware lives at src/middleware.ts, not the repo root - he stresses this at [54:38].
Convex Auth was created with providers: [] - nothing could sign in until the Password provider was added, which the tutorial does later in ch5 around [67:01].
The Tailark sign-up block has no email field, but Password auth identifies users by email. Added an Email input; without it sign-up cannot work.

combineReducers({}) throws "Store does not have a valid reducer" at runtime, so the empty slices record he sets up first is not viable on its own. Added the profile slice from [150:26] to make the store valid.

The projects schema is never narrated - he pastes it. Read the exact columns off the Convex dashboard on screen at [180:03]: name, projectNumber, createdAt, lastModified, isPublic, sketchesData, description, generatedDesignData, inspirationImages, moodBoardImages, styleGuide, tags. His table list also shows credits_grants, credits_ledger, project_counters and subscriptions, which later chapters add.
Used a project_counters table for auto-naming rather than counting rows, so deleting a project cannot make a later one reuse its number.

The dashboard UI is never narrated in detail. Read it off frames at ~205:30: circular logo, TODO:credits, help icon, avatar and a rounded-full New Project pill in the navbar; Your Projects heading with the subtitle Manage your design projects and continue where you left off; and a grid of warm gradient preview tiles with a soft white disc centred, name and relative time underneath. No card borders - the tile is the card.

Frame at ~205:30 also showed his page composition: const Page = async () => { const { projects, profile } = await ProjectsQuery() } with an Authentication Required fallback, then
. Rebuilt to match rather than the client-only grid I had first.
Frames also revealed the route structure still to come: src/app/(protected)/dashboard/[session]/(workspace)/ with layout.tsx, page.tsx and style-guide/page.tsx.

Frame at ~206:50 showed his Figma for the workspace: the navbar switches modes in project context - breadcrumb Project / Name, centred Canvas and Style Guide tabs, and the button becomes New Frame instead of New Project. That is why the navbar reads useSearchParams().get(project).
Canvas is a query param, not a path segment: /dashboard/[session]/canvas?project=<id>.

Same frame showed the Style Guide design for ch13: Colours / Typography / Moodboard tabs, a Themes dropdown (Monochrome), then swatch groups - Primary Colours, Secondary and Accent, UI Component, Utility and Form, Status and Feedback - each swatch a chip with a hex. His Figma text styles: h1 38/40, h2 30/36, h3 24/32, h4 20/28, paragraph 16/28, lead 20/28, large 18/28, small 14/20, muted 14/20, x-small 12/18, xxs 10/14, xxxs 8/14.
